english.title: Outside UK - incite another to commit an act of terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), incited another person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), to commit an act of terrorism wholly or partly outside the United Kingdom, which, if committed in England or Wales, would constitute

(A)_[an offence of murder]_
(B)_[an offence under Section 18 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861]_
(C)_[an offence under Section 23 or 24 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861]_
(D)_[an offence under Section 28 or 29 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861]_
(E)_[an offence under Section 1(2) of the Criminal Damage Act 1971]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 59(1) and (3) of the Terrorism Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) A person guilty of an offence under this Section shall be liable to any penalty to which he would be liable on conviction of the offence listed in Section 59(2) which corresponds to the act which he incites.
(ii) Consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(iii) For the purposes of this offence it is immaterial whether or not the person incited is in the United Kingdom at the time of the incitement.
(iv) See Section 1 for an interpretation of "terrorism".

other.penalty:
A person guilty of an offence under this Section shall be liable to any penalty to which he would be liable on conviction of the offence listed in Section 59(2) which corresponds to the act which he incites.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None This offence is also specified as a serious terrorism offence (Part 1 of Schedule 17A to the Sentencing Act 2020) and subject to serious terrorism sentences of imprisonment or extended sentences; see note (v) in section 306 for details.
